purpose: Recover each unclipped non-power-of-two raster slope at low interpolant magnitude and prospectively test whether the top-left and bottom-right rectangle primitives use the same coefficient. The x=0 observation pins the tile-local binary32 plane constant before the 31-pixel baseline is evaluated.

changedVariables: the sampled primitive changes from the bottom-right rectangle triangle to the top-left rectangle triangle
sample local y changes from height minus one to zero
sample x positions change from local x 1 and 31 in three later tiles to local x 0 and 31 in tile zero
record count decreases from six to two sample positions per geometry
unchangedVariables: candidate center and plus-or-minus-eight-float search window
intervention.reason: At the previous x magnitudes, output rounding hid adjacent slope values even after three independent tile constants were intersected. In tile zero, the x=0 pull directly constrains the binary32 plane constant and the x=31 pull supplies the longest same-tile baseline. Sampling the opposite triangle also makes primitive-coefficient equality a prospective, falsifiable test.

idealIdentifiabilityControl.construction: For every frozen width and witness, synthesize the four pull observations at positions 0, 15/16, 31, and 31+15/16 from the correctly rounded direct-division slope and a zero binary32 tile constant, then apply the frozen recovery procedure.

bottomRightControl.candidateMaskEncoding: zlib-compressed width-major, witness-major, geometry-major little-endian uint32; bit offset plus 8 represents candidate slope directBits plus offset

slopeRecovery.constantSharing: one recovered constant shared by both tile-zero sample positions

nonClaims: A successful primitive-equality gate does not establish how the recovered slopes were generated.
Uniquely recovering the discovery slopes does not establish a numerator law.
Uniquely recovering the discovery slopes does not establish the low-determinant mantissa or reciprocal law.
The recovered slope table requires a later prospective setup-law holdout before a production implementation is authorized.
This probe does not establish clip-generated setup.
No result from this probe establishes end-to-end Liquid Glass parity.
